Error: [CRITICAL_VULNERABILITY] Double-Payment Bug: ERP approved 2 payments for Bill 0a926809
  Payments : PAY/2026/07/03/000064 + PAY/2026/07/03/000065
  Overpaid : $1000.00
  Root Cause: ERP checks duplicate approval per payment ID (E2888) but not per bill.
  Fix Required: Backend must reject approval of any payment if bill.paid_amount >= bill.total.
